subject: txn: fix race in p-dml caused by `Transaction.SetOption` running with background flushing (#51913)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. The change adds `IsPipelined()` guards to avoid calling `Transaction/Snapshot.SetOption` on pipelined transactions while pipelined memdb may flush in background (notably in `pkg/executor/executor.go`, `pkg/executor/update.go`, `pkg/session/session.go`), reducing concurrency race risk without changing core DML correctness/consistency semantics (main impact is reduced observability/resource-tagging options for pipelined DML). Checked later history through `upstream/master` and this area was subsequently refactored (options-before-commit moved into txn manager), with no remaining Blocker/High issues attributable to this commit.
